setup.cmd: tar xzf p8.tgz && pip install -q laya && cd proj && PYTHONPATH=scripts python -c 'import monitor_lib as ml, torch; print(ml.base_dir()); print(torch.cuda.get_device_name(0))'

steps.name: smoke
cmds: bash scripts/aaai27/resume_test.sh out/resume_test 130 20 115 125 && ( python scripts/train_monitor.py --epochs 1 --max_steps 10 --bs 16 --accum 1 --seed 1 --out monitor/smoke --calib_out monitor/smoke/calibration.json --work_dir runs/smoke --resume_dir runs/smoke/resume && python scripts/aaai27/score_texts.py --model monitor/smoke --texts inputs/val_texts.jsonl --out out/smoke/val_scores.jsonl --limit 5 && for i in 1 2; do python scripts/attack.py --model monitor/smoke --calib monitor/smoke/calibration.json --data data/train_pool.jsonl --scores compute --n 3 --budget 3 --threshold 0.5 --resume --scope agent --out out/smoke/val_agent.jsonl; done && python scripts/attack.py --model monitor/smoke --calib monitor/smoke/calibration.json --data data/train_pool.jsonl --scores compute --n 3 --budget 3 --threshold 0.5 --resume --scope agent --fluent_k 20 --out out/smoke/f_val_agent.jsonl && python scripts/attack.py --model monitor/smoke --calib monitor/smoke/calibration.json --data data/train_pool.jsonl --scores compute --n 3 --budget 3 --threshold 0.5 --resume --scope all --out out/smoke/val_all.jsonl ) > logs/smoke_chain.log 2>&1 ; R=$? ; tail -5 logs/smoke_chain.log ; exit $R
logs/smoke.log

steps.name: rand_any
cmds: tar xzf rand_any.tgz && python scripts/attack.py --model monitor/laya-monitor --calib monitor/calibration.json --data data/train_pool.jsonl --scores compute --n 200 --budget 20 --scope all --random_baseline --target_ids inputs/any_u_val_ids.json --max_minutes 60 --resume --out out/rand_any/val_all_random.jsonl && python scripts/aaai27/random_any_control.py render out/rand_any/val_all_random.jsonl out/rand_any/texts.jsonl --model_dir monitor/laya-monitor && python scripts/aaai27/score_texts.py --model monitor/laya-monitor --texts out/rand_any/texts.jsonl --out out/rand_any/scores_laya-monitor.jsonl && python scripts/aaai27/score_texts.py --model base --texts out/rand_any/texts.jsonl --out out/rand_any/scores_base.jsonl && python scripts/aaai27/score_texts.py --model monitor/run1 --texts out/rand_any/texts.jsonl --out out/rand_any/scores_run1.jsonl
out/rand_any/rand_any.log

steps.name: train1
cmds: [ -s out/resume_test/attn_choice.txt ] || { echo 'missing attn_choice.txt'; exit 3; } ; ATTN=$(grep -q math out/resume_test/attn_choice.txt && echo --attn_math) ; echo attention: $(cat out/resume_test/attn_choice.txt) ; ( [ -f monitor/seed1/calibration.json ] || python scripts/train_monitor.py $ATTN --epochs 3 --bs 16 --accum 1 --max_minutes 60 --seed 1 --out monitor/seed1 --calib_out monitor/seed1/calibration.json --work_dir runs/seed1 --resume_dir runs/seed1/resume ) && tar czf monitor/seed1_small.tgz -C monitor/seed1 --exclude model.safetensors . && rm -f runs/seed1/resume/state.pt
logs/train1.log
steps.restore_cmd: mkdir -p monitor/seed1 && tar xzf monitor/seed1_small.tgz -C monitor/seed1 && ls monitor/seed1

steps.name: evals1
cmds: python scripts/aaai27/score_texts.py --model monitor/seed1 --texts inputs/val_texts.jsonl --out out/seed1/val_scores.jsonl && python scripts/eval_monitor.py --model monitor/seed1 --calib monitor/seed1/calibration.json --tag seed1 --out out/seed1
out/seed1/evals.log

steps.name: atk1_val_agent
cmds: BAR=$(python -c "import json;print(min(0.5, json.load(open('monitor/seed1/calibration.json'))['threshold']))") && python scripts/attack.py --model monitor/seed1 --calib monitor/seed1/calibration.json --data data/train_pool.jsonl --scores compute --n 200 --budget 20 --threshold $BAR --resume --scope agent --max_minutes 300 --out out/seed1/attack/val_agent.jsonl
out/seed1/attack/val_agent.log

steps.name: atk1_f_val_agent
cmds: BAR=$(python -c "import json;print(min(0.5, json.load(open('monitor/seed1/calibration.json'))['threshold']))") && python scripts/attack.py --model monitor/seed1 --calib monitor/seed1/calibration.json --data data/train_pool.jsonl --scores compute --n 200 --budget 20 --threshold $BAR --resume --scope agent --fluent_k 20 --max_minutes 300 --out out/seed1/attack/f_val_agent.jsonl
out/seed1/attack/f_val_agent.log

steps.name: atk1_val_all
cmds: BAR=$(python -c "import json;print(min(0.5, json.load(open('monitor/seed1/calibration.json'))['threshold']))") && python scripts/attack.py --model monitor/seed1 --calib monitor/seed1/calibration.json --data data/train_pool.jsonl --scores compute --n 200 --budget 20 --threshold $BAR --resume --scope all --max_minutes 200 --out out/seed1/attack/val_all.jsonl
out/seed1/attack/val_all.log
